name: RCSB PDB
description: RCSB Protein Data Bank (RCSB PDB) is a scientific data resource providing free, open access to the 3D structural data of biological macromolecules including proteins, nucleic acids, and complex assemblies.

hasPart.name: RCSB PDB Data API
hasPart.description: Provides structured access to the complete RCSB PDB holdings via REST and GraphQL interfaces.

hasPart.name: RCSB PDB Search API
hasPart.description: Full-featured search API for locating PDB identifiers matching complex query conditions including text, sequence, structure, and chemical searches.

hasPart.name: RCSB PDB ModelServer API
hasPart.description: Provides on-demand access to subsets of macromolecular model data stored in PDBx/mmCIF format.

hasPart.name: RCSB PDB VolumeServer API
hasPart.description: Delivers subsets of volumetric electron density and cryo-EM map data associated with PDB entries.

hasPart.name: RCSB PDB Sequence Coordinates API
hasPart.description: GraphQL service providing sequence-level alignments between structural databases and external sequence resources.

hasPart.name: RCSB PDB Structure Alignment API
hasPart.description: Asynchronous REST API that performs programmatic structure alignment calculations between PDB entries or user-supplied coordinate files.
